children: Strategic interest in NextDC from Goodman Group and Digital Realty could increase debate around the value of the Australian data-center operator's assets, Morgan Stanley analysts say. With NextDC having already floated the possibility of divesting itself of noncore sites, the MS analysts tell clients in a note that there could be discussion about the potential worth to others of the ASX-listed company's data centers, hyperscaler contracts and land bank. Among possible scenarios MS contemplates is for an investor to provide capital to ease NextDC's balance-sheet concerns. MS raises its target price by 42% to 9.50 Australian dollars and keeps an equal-weight recommendation on the stock, which is down 1.2% at A$9.74. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
